blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) have recently gained popularity for their ability to model functions using simple and lightweight networks. These methods have also proven effective in deformable image registration. In this work, we extend INRs for deformable image registration to the domain of temporal image registration, focusing on periodic temporal image sequences. Our approach, Temporal-IDIR, optimizes a single INR to model deformations across all frames in a temporal image sequence simultaneously, allowing for self-regularization through its own deformation predictions. To achieve this, we introduce a temporal consistency loss that penalizes discrepancies between direct source-to-target transformations and those traversing intermediate frames. We evaluate our framework on the DIR-LAB dataset, using the target registration error (TRE) between annotated and moved landmarks as the metric. Here, we achieve a TRE of 1.03 mm, outperforming other INR-based registration methods. Additionally, our framework supports smooth interpolation between time frames by estimating deformations between the given input frames. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/MMLowes/Temporal_INR.
blocks.zh: 隐性神经表达系统(INRs)最近因其使用简单和轻量级网络模拟功能的能力而得到欢迎. 这些方法在可变形图像登记方面也证明是有效的. 在这个作品中,我们将可变形图像注册的INRs扩展至时间图像注册领域,并侧重于定期时间图像序列. 我们的方法"Temperal-IDIR",优化了单一的INR,在时间图像序列中同时对所有帧的变形进行模型化,允许通过自己的变形预测进行自律. 为了实现这一点,我们引入了时间一致性损失,从而惩罚了直接源到目标转换与那些转动中间帧之间的差异。 我们利用标注和移动地标之间的目标登记错误(TRE)作为衡量标准,对DIR-LAB数据集评估我们的框架。 在这里,我们实现了1.03毫米的TRE,优于其他基于INR的登记方法. 此外,我们的框架通过估计特定输入框架之间的变形,支持时间框架之间的平滑内插。 代码可在https://github.com/MMLowes/Temporal_INR上公开查阅.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Temporal image registration is a fundamental process in image analysis that involves aligning two or more images taken at different times.
In medical imaging, temporal registration is useful for analyzing short-term sequences, such as a heart beat, a respiratory cycle, or bowel movements, as well as long-term sequences to investigate disease progression through months or years.
Registering the images across the temporal sequence offers the possibility to propagate landmarks and thereby follow the movement of anatomical structures over time.
blocks.zh:
时间图像注册是图像分析中的一个基本过程,涉及在不同时间拍摄的两个或两个以上的图像对齐.
在医学成像中,时间登记对于分析心脏跳动,呼吸循环,或肠道运动等短期序列,以及调查疾病经过数月或数年发展的长期序列都是有益的.
通过时间序列对图像进行登记,有可能传播地标,从而跟踪解剖结构随时间的移动。

blocks.en:
Standard deformable image registration (DIR) is performed pairwise by registering a source image I S I_{S} to a target image I T I_{T} .
This can be achieved by applying a deformable vector field u ⁡ ( x ) u(\textbf{x}) to map each position in the source image x to align it with the target image (see Figure 1 ).
Registration methods can be divided into two categories; optimization-based and learning-based methods.
Traditional methods using B-splines to represent the deformation vector field [ 10 , 12 , 21 ] are examples of optimization-based methods, where the parameters of the splines are optimized individually for each registration.
With convolutional neural networks, a group of learning-based registration methods appeared [ 1 , 6 , 7 , 14 , 4 , 22 ] .
This approach offers the possibility of learning the registration on one data set and generalize to new unseen data, however using 3D CNNs on large 3D image volumes requires large amounts of memory.

blocks.en:
Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) can be used as an optimization-based registration method by parameterizing the deformation field as a neural network [ 20 ] .
In the simplest form, the source point coordinate x is passed to a simple multi layer perceptron (MLP) that estimates the deformation u ⁡ ( x ) u(\textbf{x}) .
This approach significantly lowers the memory requirements by operating on continuous points, while exploiting the neural networks ability to approximate any signal or function.
Several works have expanded on the use of INRs by enforcing an inverse consistency between source-to-target and target-to-source registration [ 2 , 17 , 15 ] or applying geometric constraints [ 18 ] .
blocks.zh:
隐性神经表达法(INR)可以通过参数化变形场作为神经网络[20].
最简单的形式是,源点坐标x被传递到一个简单的多层感知器(MLP),该感知器估计变形u ⁡ (x) u (\ textbf{x}) 。 。 。
这种方法通过在连续点上操作,同时利用神经网络的能力来估计任何信号或功能,从而大大降低了内存要求.
一些著作通过在源对目标登记与目标对源登记[2, 17, 15]或应用几何限制[18]之间实现反向一致性,扩大了对INRs的使用.

blocks.en:
The described methods are developed for pair-wise image registration.
When a temporal sequence consists of more than two images, one can utilize pair-wise registration to either register the first image to all subsequent time frames ( direct registration ) or sequentially register each time frame to the next ( sequential registration ).
Assuming smooth changes over the temporal sequence, the sequential registration will only require small deformations between consecutive time steps, whereas the direct registration may require increasingly larger deformations when the time difference is large.
The sequential approach, however, builds up error through the time steps, causing problems in long sequences [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh:
描述的方法是为双向图像注册而开发的.
当一个时间序列由两个以上图像组成时,可以采用双向登记方式,将第一个图像登记到以后所有的时间框架(直接登记),或按顺序登记到下一个时间框架(顺序登记)。
假设在时间顺序上发生平稳变化,顺序登记只需在连续时间步骤之间发生小变形,而当时间差较大时,直接登记可能需要越来越大的变形。
然而,顺序法通过时间步骤积累出错误,在长序中造成问题[11].

blocks.en:
In this paper, we propose a novel method for temporal registration using INRs that combines direct and sequential registration, by simultaneously optimizing registration between all possible image pairs in a temporal image sequence.
Our main contributions include extending INR-based registration with the temporal dimension, enabling tracking of landmark movement during a whole cycle of data, contrary to only the extreme phases. Furthermore, our method tracks landmarks between the input frames of the data, giving continuous landmark movement throughout the data cycle.
We demonstrate the capabilities of the method on the open source DIR-LAB lung CT dataset [ 3 ] , and show that the proposed method outperforms other INR-based registration methods.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们提出一种新的时间登记方法,使用IRRs,将直接登记和顺序登记结合起来,同时优化时间图像序列中所有可能的图像对之间的登记。
我们的主要贡献包括将基于国家自然资源研究所的登记扩大到时间范围,以便能够在整个数据周期内跟踪标志性运动,这与极端阶段相反。 此外,我们的方法跟踪数据输入框之间的地标,使整个数据周期的地标运动持续不断。
我们在开源DIR-LAB肺CT数据集上演示了该方法的能力,并表明拟议方法的效绩超过了其他基于INR的注册方法.

In scenarios involving temporal image sequences, temporal registration is employed to map images over the given sequence of time points. This can be performed using two approaches: • Direct registration , aligning a single source frame to all other frames in the sequence e.g. f 0 → f 1 f_{0}\to f_{1} , f 0 → f 2 f_{0}\to f_{2} , etc. • Sequential registration , aligning consecutive frames to each other, such as f 0 → f 1 f_{0}\to f_{1} , f 1 → f 2 f_{1}\to f_{2} , etc. To take advantage of both strategies, we propose a unified optimization framework that simultaneously optimizes the registrations between all source-target pairs.

blocks.en:
Implicit Neural Representations. An INR consists of a simple MLP network, trained to approximate the deformation fields between all frames in the data sequence.
The INR takes a continuous coordinate 𝐱 \mathbf{x} and source and target times as input, while returning the mapping 𝐱 \mathbf{x} from source to target, see Fig. 1 .

INR 以连续坐标 x\ mathbf{x} 以及源和目标时间作为输入, 同时返回映射 x\ mathbf{x} 参见图1。

To enable the neural network to capture both low and high frequency signals we use the SIREN architecture [ 13 ] , an MLP with sinusoidal activation functions. Additionally, the physical input coordinates are encoded with a harmonic encoding, projecting the coordinates into a higher-dimensional space, while the input times are mapped to the unit circle.

blocks.en:
Temporal Inference. The registrations are evaluated based on the error between landmark in expiratory phase and landmark moved from inspiratory phase. We employ four methods for mapping from the inspiratory phase t insp t_{\text{insp}} to the expiratory phase t exp t_{\text{exp}} .
We define 𝐱 insp \mathbf{x}_{\text{insp}} as the landmark position in the inspiratory phase and 𝐱 ~ exp \tilde{\mathbf{x}}_{\text{exp}} as the estimated moved landmark position after applying the transformation.
However, the methods can be used to map from any source time to any target time.

1. The direct method calculates the transformation from t insp t_{\text{insp}} to t exp t_{\text{exp}} as 𝐱 ~ exp = Φ t insp → t exp ​ ( 𝐱 insp ) . \tilde{\mathbf{x}}_{\text{exp}}=\mathrm{\Phi}_{t_{\text{insp}}\to t_{\text{exp}}}(\mathbf{x}_{\text{insp}}). (9) 2. To move the inspiratory landmark sequentially we use the definition from Eq. 4 , moving the point one step at a time 𝐱 ~ exp = Φ t insp → t exp + ​ ( 𝐱 insp ) . \tilde{\mathbf{x}}_{\text{exp}}=\mathrm{\Phi}^{+}_{t_{\text{insp}}\to t_{\text{exp}}}(\mathbf{x}_{\text{insp}}). blocks.en: 3 Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 3 实验和结果

blocks.en:
Dataset. The DIR-LAB data set [ 3 ] consists of 4D CT scans of the lungs of 10 participants. Each 4D CT scan is composed of 10 volumetric frames ( f 0 , … , f 9 ) (f_{0},\ldots,f_{9}) where the extreme phases, the inspiratory and expiratory phases, are at f 0 f_{0} and f 5 f_{5} , respectively.
Registration from inspiratory phase to expiratory phase in DIR-LAB is commonly used to validate image registration for medical imaging [ 1 , 5 , 17 , 6 , 15 , 16 , 19 , 20 ] . In the two extreme phases of each 4D CT, 300 expert annotated landmarks are available to measure registration performance.
As common practice, we only calculate the deformation field within the lungs, with a mask obtained from Hofmanninger et al. [ 8 ] .
The DIR-LAB data set also contains 75 landmarks per patient that have been propagated from frame 0 and frame 5 to the intermediate frames, which is used to evaluate the outside the extreme phases. However, as these are not expert annotated, the results from these are not as reliable.
blocks.zh:
数据集. DIR-LAB数据集[3]包括10名参与者的肺部4D CT扫描. 每一次4D CT扫描由10个卷式帧(f 0,...,f 9) (f_{0},\ldots,f_{9})组成,其中极端阶段,呼吸阶段和过期阶段分别是f 0 f_{0}和f 5 f_{5}.
DIR-LAB从呼吸阶段到到期阶段的登记通常用于验证医疗成像的图像登记[1、5、17、6、15、16、19、20]。 在每4D CT的两个极端阶段,有300个附加说明的专家标志,用于衡量登记业绩。
作为通常的做法,我们只计算肺内的变形场,用Hofmanninger等人获得的面具. [8].
DIR-LAB数据集还包含从帧0和帧5到中间帧的每个患者75个地标,用于评价外部极端阶段. 然而,由于没有专家说明,结果并不那么可靠。

blocks.en:
Experimental Details. The INRs used for the cyclic registration are parameterized with 5 hidden layers each with 512 neurons. They are trained for 10 000 epochs using the Adam optimizer [ 9 ] with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , decaying every 1000 epochs by a factor of 0.5.
An epoch consists of 15 000 randomly sampled points within the union of lung masks for all time frames. A source and a target time are randomly sampled between 0 and 9, to accommodate each point, here the extreme phases are sampled more frequently.
blocks.zh:
实验细节. 用于循环注册的INRs被参数化,各有5个隐藏层,有512个神经元. 他们通过亚当优化器[9]接受10 000个世纪的训练,学习率为10 - 4 10 - 4 4],每1 000个世纪衰减0.5倍。
一个时代包括所有时间段的肺口罩结合范围内的15 000个随机抽样点。 一个源和一个目标时间在0到9之间随机抽样,以适应每个点,这里极端阶段的抽样比较频繁.

blocks.en:
For our optimal model, we use the hyperparameters α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 , β = 0.01 \beta=0.01 , and λ = 0.005 \lambda=0.005 for Eq. 6 . We test multiple values of β \beta , while the other parameters are taken from other INR registration frameworks.
The methods are evaluated using the target registration error (TRE) between annotated landmarks in the expiratory phase and landmarks moved from inspiratory to expiratory.
Registration over a whole cycle takes 12.5 min on an NVIDIA Geforce RTX 4090.

对于我们的最佳模型,我们使用高参数α = 0.05\α = 0.05,β = 0.01\β = 0.01,+ = 0.005\lambda = 0.005 Eq. 6. 我们测试β\β的多个值,而其他参数则取自其他的INR注册框架.
在评估这些方法时,将使用标注在过期阶段的地标与从激励到到期的地标之间的目标登记错误。
在NVIDIA Geforce RTX 4090上进行整个周期的登记需要12.5分钟。

blocks.en: 4 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 讨论和结论

blocks.en:
Our proposed framework, Temporal-IDIR, extends INR-based registration to periodic temporal data, by including two timesteps in the input to the INR and training for registration between all frames simultaneously. This enables the framework to model the movement between any two given time points in the 4D CT scans.
With the inclusion of the temporal consistency loss, Eq. 3 , in combination with the Taylor inference method, the network has a slight edge over the other INR-based registration methods on the DIR-LAB dataset.
blocks.zh:
我们拟议的框架Temporal-IDIR将基于IRR的登记扩大到定期时间数据,在向IRR的投入中列入两个时间步骤,并在所有框架之间同时进行登记培训。 这使得框架能够在4D CT扫描中模拟任意两个给定的时间点之间的运动.
随着时间一致性损失Eq. 3的加入,结合泰勒推断法,网络在DIR-LAB数据集上比其他基于INR的注册方法略微有优势.

blocks.en: Although our framework does not outperform the two methods RRN [ 6 ] and pTVreg [ 19 ] in the TRE metric, it has other advantages. INR based methods are not restricted to a grid as both these methods are, but operates on continuous points. This entails that the network size and memory load during optimization are more consistent over inputs with different sizes and resolutions.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的框架没有超过TRE度量法中的RRN[6]和pTVreg[19]两种方法,但它有其他优点. 基于INR的方法不象这两种方法一样局限于网格,而是在连续点上运行. 这就要求优化期间的网络大小和内存负载比不同大小和分辨率的投入更加一致.

blocks.en:
The temporal loss ℒ temporal \mathcal{L}_{\text{temporal}} is controlled with the β \beta -hyperparameter. Having a small value of β \beta generally gives the best results as seen in Table 2 , where especially the Taylor method obtain a low TRE. The sequential method is not on par with the other methods for small β \beta -values. Small errors propagate through multiple deformations, resulting in larger deviations when registering between extreme phases. The temporal loss penalizes this propagation of errors. Thus, we see an increase in the performance of the sequential method when increasing β \beta , until it is on par with the direct method, at β = 1.0 \beta=1.0 . At this point, there is not more to gain from the temporal loss.
The increased performance of the sequential method can, in some cases, make this method preferred to the other methods. Each deformation is smaller with the sequential method; this can give better regularity over the deformations, potentially increasing the quality of a moved object compared to moving it with one big deformation.
blocks.zh:
时间损失 L Time \ mathcal{ LQQText{时态} 用 β\ beta - hyperparameter 控制 。 β\β的数值小,一般能产生表2所示的最佳结果,其中泰勒法获得的TRE尤其低. 相继方法与小β\β-值的其他方法不同。 小错误通过多个变形传播,导致在极端阶段之间登记时出现较大的偏差. 时间损失会惩罚这种错误的传播。 因此,我们看到,在β \β 增加时,相继方法的性能会增加,直到它与直接方法相同时,在β = 1.0\β = 1.0. 此时,时间损失并没有更多好处。
相继方法的性能的提高在某些情况下会使得这种方法比其他方法更可取. 每个变形体与顺序法相比都较小;这可以使变形体比变形体更有规律性,与用一个大变形体移动相比,可能提高被移动物体的质量.

blocks.en:
As the temporal inputs to the model are sampled from the unit circle, our framework is capable of modeling the movement of landmarks continuously, as opposed to only modeling the movement between extreme phases.
The network is trained with 10 different temporal inputs, corresponding to the 10 frames in the 4D CT scans. However, as Fig. 3 (a,b) shows, we are able to input any encoding from the unit circle as the temporal input. This enables our method to interpolate between the 10 time frames on which it was trained and to do a continuous smooth movement of landmarks.
In general, the framework can be trained with input with any number of temporal dimensions, but inference can also be done with higher resolution than the training process.
The ability to model movement over the whole sequence of the data makes our method better suited for practical use, as clinical cases involving organ movement, e.g. the heart movement, the whole temporal movement is of interest.
blocks.zh:
由于对模型的时间投入是从单位圈中抽取的,所以我们的框架能够连续地模拟地标的移动,而不是仅仅模拟极端阶段之间的移动.
网络训练有10种不同的时间输入,对应4D CT扫描中的10帧. 然而,如图3(a,b)所示,我们能够从单位圆输入任何编码作为时间输入. 这使得我们的方法能够在它接受培训的10个时限之间插上插图,并不断平稳地移动地标。
一般来说,可以通过任何时间层面的投入对框架进行培训,但推论的分辨率也可以高于培训过程。
在整个数据序列上建立运动模型的能力使我们的方法更适合实际使用,因为涉及器官运动的临床案例,例如心脏运动,整个时间运动是值得注意的.

blocks.en: In conclusion, our INR-based temporal registration method is able to capture the movement of the lungs over a respiratory cycle. The registration quality is better than other INR-based registration frameworks. Additionally, our method models the movement across the entire period of the data, and enables interpolation between the frames of the input modality, making the registration continuous in time.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们基于国际康复和营养研究所的时间登记方法能够捕捉肺在呼吸循环中的运动。 登记质量优于基于国家登记处的其他登记框架。 此外,我们的方法模拟了整个数据期间的移动情况,并使得输入模式的框架之间能够进行插值,使登记能够持续。
